name: io.github.Erodenn/godot-mcp-runtime
title: Godot MCP Runtime
description: Zero-addon MCP server for Godot 4.5 or later: agents edit, run, and play-test the game.

environmentVariables.name: GODOT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the Godot 4.5 or later executable. Auto-detected if Godot is on PATH.

environmentVariables.name: DEBUG
environmentVariables.description: Enable verbose logging when set to 'true'.

environmentVariables.name: GODOT_MCP_DISABLE_ELICITATION
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to skip the once-per-project confirmation prompts for run_project, render_movie and run_script (the call proceeds with a warning) for clients that cannot display elicitation, e.g. Claude Desktop.
